title: Derivations as Algebras
summary: Differential categories provide the categorical foundations for the algebraic approaches to differentiation. They have been successful in formalizing various important concepts related to differentiation, such as, in particular, derivations. In this paper, we show that the differential modality of a differential category lifts to a monad on the arrow category and, moreover, that the algebras of this monad are precisely derivations.
